missing.reason: AccumulatorExpressions.bottom writes the accumulator's output field. The $bottom expression operator takes the array to rank as input.
AccumulatorExpressions.bottomN writes the accumulator's output field. The $bottomN expression operator takes the array to rank as input.
ConvertType has no array target. MongoDB 8.3 converts strings and other inputs to arrays with to: "array".
ConvertType has no binData target. MongoDB 9.0 converts an object to its raw BSON as binData.
ConvertType has no object target. MongoDB 8.3 converts strings and other inputs to objects with to: "object".
ConvertExpression has no format option. MongoDB 8.3 requires format when converting between binData and string.
ConvertType has no binData target with a subtype. $convert takes to: {type: "binData", subtype: n} for binary subtypes.
FilterExpression has no arrayIndexAs option. MongoDB 8.3 names the element's index variable with arrayIndexAs.
MapExpression has no arrayIndexAs option. MongoDB 8.3 names the element's index variable with arrayIndexAs.
AccumulatorExpressions.top writes the accumulator's output field. The $top expression operator takes the array to rank as input.
AccumulatorExpressions.topN writes the accumulator's output field. The $topN expression operator takes the array to rank as input.
ArrayExpressions.concatArrays always writes an array of its arguments. As an accumulator, $concatArrays takes one array expression, written without the array.
SetExpressions.setUnion always writes an array of its arguments. As an accumulator, $setUnion takes one array expression, written without the array.
CurrentOp has no targetAllNodes option. MongoDB 7.1 reports every node of a sharded cluster with targetAllNodes.
Out has no timeseries options. $out can create a time series collection, with bucketMaxSpanSeconds and bucketRoundingSeconds since MongoDB 6.3.
FindOptions has no elemMatch projection. Filters.elemMatch is the query predicate; a find can't project the first matching array element with $elemMatch.
ArrayExpressions.concatArrays always writes an array of its arguments. As a window function, $concatArrays takes one array expression, written without the array.
SetExpressions.setUnion always writes an array of its arguments. As a window function, $setUnion takes one array expression, written without the array.
